title: Windows GPU unit tests job fails with PowerShell execution policy error before running tests
signature: windows gpu unit tests extract openvino packages setupvars.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled on this system pssecurityexception unauthorizedaccess|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Extract OpenVINO packages step failed with PSSecurityException/UnauthorizedAccess when PowerShell tried to dot-source a generated .ps1 wrapper script because script execution is disabled on the self-hosted Windows runner.

key_errors: . : File C:\actions-runner\_work\_temp\2d01ed21-90a4-4241-8343-bd39b0dc542c.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled on this system. For more information, see about_Execution_Policies at https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=135170.
root_cause: The 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step runs under `shell: powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1). GitHub Actions implements this by writing the step's `run:` block to a generated temporary .ps1 file under _temp and dot-sourcing it. On this self-hosted Windows runner (ptl pool), the PowerShell execution policy for the account/session used by the Actions runner service is set to Restricted (or was reset, e.g. by a runner/image update or policy refresh), which blocks loading any unsigned script file, including the runner's own auto-generated wrapper. This is an environment/runner configuration issue on the self-hosted machine, not a problem with the workflow YAML or the extracted archives themselves - the same job previously failed on the same step due to a different infra issue (locked tbb12.dll from a stale extraction), confirming this runner has a history of extraction-step instability.
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires the specific self-hosted Windows runner (ptl pool) whose PowerShell execution policy is restricted. Locally: set `Set-ExecutionPolicy Restricted -Scope Process` (or CurrentUser) then run any `shell: powershell` step to reproduce the PSSecurityException.
recommended_actions: On the affected self-hosted Windows runner(s), run `Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope LocalMachine -Force` (or Bypass/Unrestricted per org policy) for the account running the Actions runner service, then verify with `Get-ExecutionPolicy -List`.

Check whether a recent base-image update, group policy push, or security hardening script reset the execution policy on this runner pool and if so, bake the required policy into the runner image/provisioning script so it survives reimaging.

Add an explicit `Set-ExecutionPolicy` bootstrap step (or runner startup hook) to self-hosted Windows runner provisioning so execution policy drift is caught/corrected automatically rather than failing mid-pipeline.
Consider adding a lightweight runner health-check job that verifies `Get-ExecutionPolicy` before accepting GPU unit test workloads, to fail fast with a clearer message.
prevention_strategies: Pin and periodically audit the PowerShell execution policy on all self-hosted Windows runners used for GPU/Windows jobs as part of runner provisioning/imaging, and add monitoring/alerting for execution-policy drift so it is caught before it blocks post-commit CI.
historical_context: The same 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step on the Windows GPU unit tests job has failed repeatedly (11 recorded occurrences, pattern 514ffa2ab52ad344) due to a different root cause: 'Access to the path ... tbb12.dll is denied' from a locked DLL left over by a previous run. This is the first recorded occurrence of the distinct PSSecurityException/execution-policy failure signature on this step, indicating the step is fragile across multiple failure modes tied to this self-hosted Windows runner pool's environment state.
